title.hr: Načelo četiri oka: kad drugi potpis postane formalnost
title.en: Four eyes: when the second approver is a rubber stamp

concept.hr: Drugi potpis hvata neispravan zahtjev samo ako ga neovisan odobravatelj pogleda
concept.en: A second signature stops a bad request only if an independent approver looks

summary.hr: Pošalji mjesec zahtjeva s nekoliko neispravnih, postavi red, neovisnost i udio detaljnog pregleda; uhvaćenih je sve manje, a zapis ostaje potpun.
summary.en: Send a month of requests with a few bad ones, set the approver's queue, independence and in-depth share; fewer are caught while the record stays complete.
